fields.headline: Resistance & Power Simulator for Small Fast Craft
fields.lead: A free resistance and power simulator for speedboats and small passenger vessels: enter hull dimensions, displacement, deadrise and design speed to sweep speed and plot resistance, effective power, brake power and % MCR.

fields.title: Resistance & Power Simulator for Small Fast Craft

fields.content:
Methods

  • Planing craft — Savitsky (1964): force and moment balance with thrust angle, ITTC-57 friction, spray, wind and appendages.
  • Small passenger vessels — Holtrop–Mennen: friction with form factor, wave, transom, correlation, appendages and wind.

Results

  • Resistance and power curves by speed, with the resistance broken down by component.
  • Method validity range and porpoising limit checks.
  • Word and Excel reports; Vietnamese and English interface.

Results are for a preliminary estimate of main-engine power; a final design needs a full calculation — see our passenger boat design.

fields.heading: Need a full calculation for approval?
fields.description: Simulation results are indicative at the preliminary stage. Send us the vessel particulars and we will prepare the calculations and documents for approval.
